title: P1-12r simulate-structured: Add kind, action_id, mock_output, suspension_reason fields to SimulationStep (per master §75)
description: Feature P1-12r (revision of black-hat-revised vb-upqq9). Black-hat review round 1 found that the original bead cited 'simulate_workflow is unstructured' as the framing, but the function is ALREADY structured. Real source: crates/vb_cli/src/commands_workflow/mod.rs:30-60 (simulate_workflow returns SimulationResult { steps: Vec<SimulationStep>, total_steps, action_count, branch_count }; the function is implemented and tested). The black-hat also flagged that the cited line range 95-125 was wrong; the actual implementation is at lines 30-60. The real gap, per master §75, is that SimulationStep lacks four required fields: (1) `kind: StepKind` (the type of step: Set, Do, Wait, etc.), (2) `action_id: Option<ActionId>` (the action for Do steps; None for non-Do steps), (3) `mock_output: Option<Vec<u8>>` (the mock action's output, for Do steps using mock actions; None otherwise), (4) `suspension_reason: Option<SuspensionReason>` (why the step suspended, for Wait/Ask/Do; None otherwise). Real source: commands_workflow/mod.rs:17-26 (SimulationStep struct definition — currently has 4 fields; missing the 4 above). This bead adds the 4 fields, populates them in the existing simulation logic, and ensures the JSON output schema matches master §75. Kani harness: prove SimulationStep::json_serialize never panics on any step kind. proptest: 100 random workflows produce 100% valid JSON output.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL include kind, action_id, mock_output, suspension_reason fields in every SimulationStep (per master §75)
THE SYSTEM SHALL serialize SimulationStep to JSON with the 4 fields present (even if None)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN simulate_workflow is called and a step is a Do step with action_id=42 and mock=EchoAction
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit SimulationStep { kind: Do, action_id: Some(42), mock_output: Some(input_bytes), suspension_reason: None, .. }

event_driven.trigger: WHEN simulate_workflow is called and a step is a Wait step that suspends on deadline=1000ms
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit SimulationStep { kind: Wait, action_id: None, mock_output: None, suspension_reason: Some(AwaitingDeadline(1000)), .. }

unwanted.condition: IF a step is a Set or Finish (no action, no suspension)
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT emit a non-None action_id, mock_output, or suspension_reason; they must be None
unwanted.because: Master §75: only Do has action_id+mock_output; only Wait/Ask/Do have suspension_reason

preconditions: SimulationResult at commands_workflow/mod.rs:23-26 is already structured (steps, total_steps, action_count, branch_count)
simulate_workflow at commands_workflow/mod.rs:30-60 is already implemented
postconditions: SimulationStep has 8 fields (was 4): id, name, kind, action_id, mock_output, suspension_reason, duration_estimate, notes
JSON output includes all 8 fields, with the 4 new fields as Option types that serialize as null when None
No regression: existing fields (id, name, duration_estimate, notes) are preserved
invariants: action_id is Some iff kind == Do
mock_output is Some iff kind == Do AND the action has a mock registered
suspension_reason is Some iff kind is Wait/Ask/Do (i.e., the step suspended)

simulate_do_step_with_mock_has_action_id_and_mock_output: workflow with `do: { action: 42, input: x }` and EchoAction mock; simulate; assert step.kind == Do, step.action_id == Some(42), step.mock_output == Some(input_bytes)
error: simulate_wait_step_has_suspension_reason: workflow with `wait: { event: x, timeout: y }`; simulate; assert step.suspension_reason == Some(AwaitingDeadline(timeout))
negative_test_compile_failure_path_returns_typed_error: a malformed input is rejected with the correct typed error code (per schema contract)
edge: proptest_simulate_json_round_trip: 100 random workflows; assert the JSON output has all 8 fields and parses back to SimulationStep
kani_simulate_step_serialize_does_not_panic: bounded model check with 8 step kinds and 3 action types (24 combinations)

files: master doc §75 (the simulation output schema — the authoritative spec)
patterns: Pattern: existing SimulationStep fields are all Option types; the 4 new fields follow the same pattern (Option<T>)
questions: Should SuspensionReason be a flat enum (AwaitingDeadline, AwaitingEvent, AwaitingAsk) or a structured variant (AwaitingDeadline { ms: u64 })? Recommend: structured variant to allow more fields in the future (e.g., AwaitingAsk { prompt: String, timeout_ms: Option<u64> })

data_integrity_failures.failure: User runs `vb simulate` and gets a JSON without the action_id field; downstream tooling that expects action_id crashes on missing field
data_integrity_failures.prevention: All 8 fields are always present in the JSON output (with null for None)
data_integrity_failures.test_for_it: simulate_json_always_includes_all_8_fields: proptest with 100 random workflows; assert all 8 fields are present in the JSON

security_failures.failure: mock_output leaks sensitive data (e.g., a hashed password) into the JSON output; the user expects None but gets Some(bytes)
security_failures.prevention: mock_output is only populated for explicit mock actions (Echo, ComputeHash, Delay); user-defined actions get None
security_failures.test_for_it: simulate_user_defined_action_has_none_mock_output: workflow with a non-mock action; simulate; assert step.mock_output is None
